verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an 80-85-page script artifact as the prospective follow-on deliverable; its target length is an implementation-relevant acceptance condition.
The source identifies a material unresolved distinction between screenplay pages and comic pages that changes the adaptation's length and story coverage.
The client explicitly sets the script artifact's target length to 85 comic pages, resolving the page-unit uncertainty without leaving a stale conflicting attribute.
The same-message MODIFY resolves the prior VALUE ambiguity during v0.6 replay, so a separate RESUME adds no distinct lifecycle transition.

ambiguity.description: It is unresolved whether the 80-85-page adaptation should feel self-contained or end in a continuation-oriented way.

verdicts.decision_note: The source leaves the script artifact's ending structure unresolved, but it delegates exact story coverage to the adapter rather than presenting that coverage as a separate unresolved client decision.

The client explicitly states that no full-adaptation work is currently requested and that the project will proceed only after a successful campaign, placing the deliverable in a deferred lifecycle state.
